info.cumPct: The orange line adds up the % of total downtime accumulated by the assets from left to right. Where it crosses 80% you can see how few assets concentrate most of the downtime: focus maintenance there. The last one always reaches 100% because you have counted all the assets.
info.availability: Availability = MTBF ÷ (MTBF + MTTR). It rises when failures are rare and repaired quickly.
info.mtbf: Mean time between failures: period duration divided by the number of corrective WOs. Improves as more data is recorded.
info.comparePeriod: Compares the visible period against the previous period of equal length. Cards show ▲/▼ with the change: green if it improved, red if it worsened.

chain.howItWorks: Each audit record has a unique digital fingerprint (SHA-256 hash) that includes the previous record's fingerprint. This forms a chain: if anyone deleted or modified even a single record, the chain would break and the exact moment would be recorded. This button verifies the entire chain in real time.

nexi.question: How was the sealing failure on Llenadora L-1 resolved?
nexi.answer:
In today's **WO 26-0147**, Román Ferreyra found the sealing jaw misaligned and the sealer heater below its temperature set point.

__Solution:__ he realigned the jaw, replaced the heater and verified the seal with a leak test on 20 ampoules.
__Duration:__ 48 min · __Downtime:__ 1h 35m

Guide **GU-014** recommends checking the sealer thermocouple at the next preventive maintenance.
nexi.src1Text: Sealing jaw misaligned and heater below set point. Jaw realigned, heater replaced and leak test passed.
nexi.src2Text: Before restarting the line, check the sealing temperature (±2 °C of set point) and jaw alignment. Inspect the thermocouple every 3 months.
nexi.src3Text: Intermittent readings from the sealer position sensor. Sensor replaced and trigger point calibrated.
